selection_rule: Within each category_l2, rank product IDs by SHA256(p7_quick32_v1:42:category_l2:product_id); take first 4. No output or quality-based exclusion.
blinding_rule: Within each selected category, SHA256-rank using p7_quick32_ab namespace; first 2 Base-as-A, other 2 LoRA-as-A. Independent p7_quick32_order namespace for row order.
sampling_timing: after generation started, before any human quality results; source-ID/category-only selection, not claimed to precede all generation
formal_denominator: unchanged core attributes, only selected 32 products for human metrics; never extrapolate counts to 200
decision: User reviews evidence for no clear factuality/coverage regression and expression benefit; no new numeric hard gate invented; no automatic test execution.
